finding: The under-40 blind spot is a ranking limit of dermoscopy models trained on these archives. Decision layers move referrals between age bands and do not create sensitivity at equal workload. The deployed stack (V1 + S56 per-band abstention) fails its contract on the reserved cohort, so V4 closes without a HAM test read.

open_decisions.why: V4 pooled models beat V1 by about +0.18 Macro-F1 on reserved (S54 Gate A, confounded), but S56's thresholds need cross-fitted OOF predictions, which no V4 model has
